content: Implement controller and validation schemas for PATCH /api/users/:id with authorization and field stripping
activeForm: Implementing controller and validation schemas for PATCH /api/users/:id with authorization and field stripping
description: Implement user.controller.ts with updateUserProfile method that handles PATCH /api/users/:id endpoint. Implements authorization checks (users can only update own profile, 403 for others), field-level stripping (remove id, created_at, updated_at, password_hash, email from updates), and Zod partial validation schema. Uses repository layer from T2.1. Write 15 MVP-tier tests (unit tests for authorization logic and field stripping, integration tests for controller-repository interaction). This subtask will be integrated with routes in T2.3.

checkpoints.name: Validation Schemas Complete
checkpoints.requirement: Zod partial validation schema created for updateUser with field stripping logic

checkpoints.name: Controller Implementation with Authorization Tests
checkpoints.requirement: Controller implementation complete with first 10 tests passing (authorization and field stripping verified)

phases.name: Validation Schema Implementation
actions: Implement: updateUserSchema = createUserSchema.partial() for partial updates
Implement: stripNonUpdatableFields() helper to remove id, created_at, updated_at, password_hash, email
Allow: full_name, bio, avatar_url, location_city, location_state, phone, status updates
Validate: phone number format, avatar_url as valid URL
Export: schemas for route integration in T2.3
phases.gate: Partial schema must allow missing fields and strip non-updatable fields before proceeding

phases.name: Controller Implementation
actions: Check: Authorization - verify req.user.id === req.params.id (403 if mismatch)
Strip: Non-updatable fields from req.body before update
Return: 200 with updated user object, 403 if unauthorized, 404 if user not found

phases.name: MVP Test Suite (15 tests)
actions: Write: 8 unit tests for controller authorization logic and field stripping
Write: 7 integration tests for controller-repository interaction and validation
Verify: All 15 tests passing with 90%+ coverage of controller layer
Verify: Authorization checks prevent cross-user updates
Verify: Non-updatable fields are stripped before database update
